consequence.statement: The metric still works but is deprecated; use cilium_node_health_connectivity_status instead.

original.statement: The metric cilium_node_connectivity_status is deprecated in favour of cilium_node_health_connectivity_status.

decision.reason: [ev-82ab63ec4bf8] lists `cilium_node_connectivity_status` under "Deprecated Metrics" in the 1.17 upgrade notes and says to use `cilium_node_health_connectivity_status` instead. Nothing there says the metric is removed or stops being reported, so the proposed consequence fits: kind deprecation, class review-required, severity low. The other item in the same section [ev-ac4018b89668] follows the same deprecation-only pattern, which supports this reading.
